上海，1930年4月22日
致外侨科：

请告知我，《国际新闻通讯》（International Press Correspondence）近期各期是否包含任何涉及泛太平洋秘书处或该秘书处活动的内容。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, THURSDAY, APRIL 17, 1930
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 1201
Date..26...4...30.

OUR AUSTRALIAN LETTER

Trade Union Congress
At the conference of the All-Australian Trade Unions Congress, time was devoted to industrial legislation formulations in regard to the Arbitration, Crimes, and Transport Workers Acts. The question of their affiliation with the Pan-Pacific Secretariat was put before the unions and brought forth much feeling, expressed both by those of the moderate section who disfavoured the continuance of the association of Australia's Unions with the Secretariat, and those known as the 'reds,' who loudly and strongly advocated adherence to the organization. The voting upon the question found the moderates in a majority, but the extremist party are not satisfied with their defeat and will endeavour to have the question again submitted to the Congress. This does not seem to be a likely remedy for their defeat, although the moderates' majority was not perhaps overwhelming. Still, it was a good working one and is not likely to be reversed by many votes.

我们的澳大利亚来信

工会代表大会
在全澳工会代表大会会议上，与会者花时间制定了关于《仲裁法》、《犯罪法》和《运输工人法》的工业立法方案。关于其加入泛太平洋秘书处的问题被提交给各工会讨论，并引发了强烈的情绪反应：温和派反对澳大利亚工会继续与该秘书处保持关联，而被称为“赤色分子”的激进派则大声且强烈地主张坚持加入该组织。就该问题进行的投票结果显示温和派占多数，但极端派对他们的失败并不满意，并将努力促使该问题再次提交大会审议。这似乎不太可能成为扭转其败局的良策，尽管温和派的多数优势或许并非压倒性的。尽管如此，这一多数优势足以有效运作，且不太可能因少数票数的变动而被逆转。
